question: What claim about scope is at stake in relating the group of all fields to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs?
premises: A group of all fields is related to them.
inference: The total group of fields is presented as belonging to the class of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
uncertainties: The exact relation between fields and yoginīs is not specified by this verse alone.
plain_english: The group of all fields belongs to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
